body:
# ASO Strategy: Summer + NFL 2026

Delivering the full App Store Optimization plan for Underdog Sports covering World Cup 2026 (June–July), NBA playoffs overlap, and NFL 2026 (August–September launch window).

---

## 1. Keyword Strategy by Season Phase

### Phase 1: World Cup 2026 (Go-Live: May 15 → July 19)

**Primary keywords (highest intent, ranked by priority):**

| Keyword | Volume Est. | Competition | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| world cup fantasy | High (seasonal spike) | Low–Med | Underserved; DK/FD not optimized for soccer |
| soccer fantasy app | Med | Low | Format match; captures casual new audience |
| soccer pick em | Med | Low | Direct product match; Underdog owns this |
| world cup picks | High (seasonal) | Low | Casual predictor audience; top-of-funnel |
| soccer fantasy picks | Med | Low | Bridges fantasy + picks intent |
| pick em soccer 2026 | Med | Low | Year-tagged = lower comp, high precision |
| football fantasy app | Med-High | Med | UK/international "football" = soccer |
| world cup fantasy football | High | Med | Global term; capture soccer-literate audience |
| soccer prop picks | Low-Med | Low | Props-native audience; growing post-PrizePicks |

**Long-tail opportunities:**
- "world cup pick em game"
- "soccer fantasy draft 2026"
- "2026 world cup predictor app"
- "best world cup fantasy app US"

---

### Phase 2: NBA Stretch (April–June, running concurrently)

**Primary keywords:**

| Keyword | Volume | Competition | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| NBA pick em | Med | Med | Core product; playoff intent surges |
| NBA fantasy app | High | High | Competitive but necessary for broad reach |
| NBA best ball | Low-Med | Low | Underdog format advantage; own this niche |
| basketball pick em | Med | Low | Alternative query; capture casual bball fans |
| NBA prop picks | Med | Med | Growing; displaced PrizePicks users |
| NBA fantasy picks | Med | Med | Bridge term between fantasy + picks |

---

### Phase 3: NFL Best Ball Draft Season (Go-Live: July 15 → September 7)

**Primary keywords:**

| Keyword | Volume | Competition | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| best ball fantasy football | High | Med | Underdog invented best ball — must own #1 |
| NFL best ball | High | Med | Season-specific; surges July–August |
| best ball fantasy app | High | Low–Med | App-intent modifier; high conversion |
| fantasy football draft app | High | High | Broadest intent; expensive but necessary |
| NFL fantasy picks | High | High | Generic but volume justifies inclusion |
| football pick em app | Med | Low | Core product, NFL context |
| NFL prop picks | Med | Med | Underserved by DK/FD at app-store level |
| best ball draft 2026 | Med | Low | Year-tagged; own before competitors optimize |
| no waivers fantasy football | Low | Very Low | Best-ball-specific attribute; niche but converting |
| NFL fantasy draft picks | Med | Med | Combo term; long-tail value |

**Brand defense terms (always-on):**
- "underdog fantasy"
- "underdog sports app"
- "underdog best ball"

---

## 2. Keyword Gap Analysis: Underdog vs. PrizePicks, DraftKings, FanDuel

### What Competitors Own (Avoid Head-On)
- **DraftKings**: "daily fantasy sports", "DFS app", "sports betting app" — avoid bidding on DFS generic terms where DK has insurmountable brand equity
- **FanDuel**: "sports betting", "NFL fantasy football" — too expensive to compete directly on broad terms
- **PrizePicks**: "player props", "sports pick em" — **Opportunity**: PrizePicks is in legal/regulatory turbulence in 2026; their users are actively searching for alternatives

### Underdog's Exploitable Gaps

| Gap | Why It's Open | Underdog Play |
|---|---|---|
| "best ball fantasy" | DK/FD don't offer true best ball | Own this format term completely |
| "world cup fantasy app" | None of the major 3 optimized for soccer | First-mover advantage for World Cup |
| "soccer pick em" | PrizePicks not strong in soccer; DK/FD not pick'em | Underdog can own June–July |
| "no waivers fantasy" | Ultra-niche best-ball attribute | Underserved; high-intent buyers |
| "season-long fantasy draft" | DFS players transitioning to season formats | Bridge DFS audience |
| "NFL draft app" (no-bet framing) | DK/FD carry betting associations | Underdog = skill-game framing wins |
| "best ball 2026 NFL" | Year-tagged, low comp | Own before Aug 1 |
| "pick em football no money down" | Free-to-play angle | Acquisition play for casual audience |

---

## 3. Metadata Recommendations

### App Name (stable year-round)
**Recommended:** `Underdog: Fantasy Sports & Draft`
- Anchors brand + format + sport = keyword coverage across all seasons
- Avoid locking "Best Ball" in the name — too narrow for World Cup season

### Subtitle Strategy (rotate by season phase)

**Phase 1 — World Cup (May 15 – July 19):**
`Soccer Pick'em & Fantasy Draft`
- Leads with soccer to capture World Cup audience
- Retains draft for NFL pre-registration signaling

**Phase 2 — NFL Launch (July 20 – Sept 7):**
`Best Ball NFL Draft & Pick'em`
- Best ball leads (Underdog's differentiator)
- NFL explicit for peak search intent

**Phase 3 — NFL In-Season (Sept 8+):**
`NFL Best Ball, Pick'em & Props`
- Props explicit to compete for displaced PrizePicks audience
- Best ball retains ownership signal

### Description Architecture

**Structure for all phases:**
1. **First 3 lines** (above fold — most critical): Lead with the season-specific hook, prize pool social proof, and format differentiator
2. **Lines 4–10**: Feature bullets with keyword-rich language
3. **Bottom section**: Social proof (ratings, press mentions), legal disclaimers, CTA

**World Cup Phase Copy (above fold):**
> The #1 soccer fantasy pick'em app for World Cup 2026. Make your picks, join the biggest soccer contests, and win real prizes — no betting license needed.

**NFL Phase Copy (above fold):**
> America's best ball fantasy football app. Draft your NFL team, set it and forget it — no waiver wire, no trades, just wins.

**Keyword integration targets for description body:**
- World Cup phase: "soccer fantasy", "world cup picks", "soccer pick em", "fantasy sports app", "pick em game"
- NFL phase: "best ball", "fantasy football draft", "NFL picks", "best ball fantasy football", "football pick em"

## 5. App Preview Video Concept

### World Cup Preview (30 seconds)
- **0–3s Hook**: "The World Cup is here. Are you in?" over match footage
- **3–12s Value**: Rapid cuts of pick'em interface, live score updates, leaderboard climbing
- **12–20s Proof**: Prize screen + "Already joined by 3M+ fans"
- **20–27s Feature**: Draft interface, player cards, quick contest entry
- **27–30s CTA**: "Download free. Play today."
- **Music**: High-energy, percussive. Stadium ambiance.
- **Aspect ratio**: 9:16 portrait (primary), 16:9 landscape (secondary)

### NFL Preview (30 seconds)
- **0–3s Hook**: "Fantasy football. But you never have to check it again." (pattern interrupt)
- **3–12s Value**: Best ball draft sequence, auto-lineup, "No waivers" UI callout
- **12–20s Proof**: Prize pool display, winner testimonial graphic, 4.8 star rating
- **20–27s Feature**: Pick'em + props add-on, weekly contests
- **27–30s CTA**: "Free draft entry. This week only."
- **Music**: Stadium rock / hype build.

---

## 6. A/B Testing Roadmap

### Phase 1: Pre-World Cup (Now to May 15)

**Test 1 — Icon Test**
- Control: Current Underdog icon
- Variant A: Soccer ball integrated into icon
- Variant B: World Cup trophy motif
- Success metric: Tap-through rate (TTR) lift 15%+
- Duration: 3 weeks minimum
- Decision rule: Ship winner before May 15 go-live

**Test 2 — Subtitle Copy**
- Control: Current subtitle
- Variant A: "Soccer Pick'em & Fantasy Draft"
- Variant B: "World Cup Picks + Fantasy Sports"
- Success metric: Impressions-to-install rate
- Duration: 2 weeks

### Phase 2: World Cup Active (May 15 – July 19)

**Test 3 — Hero Screenshot**
- Control: Soccer pick'em UI
- Variant A: Prize pool / leaderboard hero
- Variant B: Player card / draft hero
- Success metric: CVR from store page
- Duration: 3 weeks (then lock winner for remainder of tournament)

**Test 4 — Description First Line**
- Control: Feature-led opening
- Variant A: Prize-led ("$1M+ in prizes")
- Variant B: Social proof-led ("5M+ fans can't be wrong")
- Duration: 2 weeks

### Phase 3: NFL Pre-Launch (July 1 – August 10)

**Test 5 — Screenshot Sequence Order**
- Control: Draft-first sequence
- Variant A: Prize-first sequence
- Variant B: "No waivers" feature-first sequence
- Success metric: CVR from product page
- Duration: 4 weeks

**Test 6 — Icon: NFL vs. Multi-sport**
- Control: Current icon (or WC winner)
- Variant A: NFL helmet motif
- Variant B: Multi-sport collage
- Decision rule: Ship winner by August 1 before NFL draft season peaks

### Phase 4: NFL In-Season (Sept 8+)

**Test 7 — Subtitle: Best Ball vs. Pick'em lead**
- Test which format descriptor drives higher CVR from NFL audience
- Ongoing 2-week cycles through Week 6 of NFL season

**Testing guardrails:**
- Run on App Store product page tests AND Google Play experiments in parallel
- Minimum 500 impressions/variant/day before reading results
- Statistical significance threshold: 95%
- Never run more than 2 simultaneous tests per store

---

## 7. Ratings & Reviews Campaign

### Target State
- **World Cup launch**: 4.7 stars+ with 10K+ reviews visible
- **NFL Week 1**: 4.8 stars+ with 25K+ reviews

### Tactics

**In-App Prompt Optimization:**
- Trigger prompt at peak satisfaction moments: immediately after first payout, after leaderboard climb, after successful draft completion
- Never prompt after a loss or during onboarding friction
- iOS: Use SKStoreReviewRequestAPI — limit to 3 prompts/year. Time them for World Cup, NFL Draft week, NFL Playoffs
- Android: In-app review API — trigger at same moments

**Pre-World Cup Push (April 15 – May 15):**
- Email/push to existing active users: "Help us earn 5 stars before the World Cup. Rate us now."
- Segment by engagement: target users with 3+ sessions in past 30 days
- Goal: +5K reviews in 30 days

**Post-Positive Experience Nudge:**
- After any user receives a payout: in-app message "Enjoying your wins? Leave us a review — it takes 10 seconds."
- After completing a best ball draft: "Your team is set. Mind taking 10 seconds to rate us?"

**Review Response Strategy:**
- Respond to every 1-star and 2-star review within 48 hours
- Template: Acknowledge issue → escalate to support → invite re-rate
- Assign: 1 team member owns daily review response queue
- Goal: Convert 20% of 1–2 star reviews to re-rates after resolution

**NFL Week 1 Blitz (September 8–14):**
- Mass push notification + email: "Season is live. Love Underdog? Tell the world."
- In-app banner on Week 1 scoring screen
- Target: +10K reviews in NFL Week 1 alone

---

## 8. Competitive Monitoring Plan

- Check monthly (or when a competitor pushes an app update): DraftKings, FanDuel, PrizePicks app store screenshots and metadata
- Keyword ranking shifts using AppFollow/Sensor Tower/data.ai
- App store ratings trend — catch if a competitor drops in rating, which is an opportunity to capture disgruntled users
- Set App Store Connect and Google Play Console keyword rank alerts for our 20 primary terms. React within 72 hours if a primary keyword drops 5+ positions.

---

| Date | Action |
|---|---|

| May 1–14 | Lock World Cup metadata, upload new screenshots |
| May 15 | World Cup keyword set live, WC screenshots live, WC video live |
| July 1 | Begin NFL pre-launch metadata update, launch screenshot A/B test |
| July 15 | Full NFL metadata live, NFL video live |
| August 1 | Ship winning icon variant for NFL season |
| Sept 1 | Pre-NFL Week 1 review blitz begins |
| Sept 8 | NFL Week 1 push; full in-season monitoring mode |
